name: gizza-ai/image-canvas-resize
summary: Change an image canvas size without scaling pixels, padding or cropping by anchor

tool.description: Change an image canvas to an exact width x height without scaling the source pixels. If the canvas grows, new margins are filled with fill; if it shrinks, source pixels are cropped. anchor chooses where the source is pinned (center, top, bottom, left, right, top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right). fill accepts hex colours (#rgb, #rgba, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa), common names, or transparent. Returns a PNG. Provide the image as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref from a prior tool call.

anchor.description: Where to pin the source image on the new canvas: controls padding when growing and what gets cropped when shrinking.

fill.description: Fill colour for newly exposed canvas: #rgb, #rgba, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, white, black, red, green, blue, gray, or transparent.

height.description: Output canvas height in pixels. Source pixels are not scaled.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

width.description: Output canvas width in pixels. Source pixels are not scaled.
